---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or an improvement to an existing one
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
---
## The problem

What are you trying to do, and why is DeepListener currently getting in the way? Describe the real learning/maintenance scenario, not just the solution you have in mind.

## Proposed solution

What would you like DeepListener to do, concretely?

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you've tried, or other tools that solve this differently.

## Scope check

- [ ] I searched existing [issues](https://github.com/zhouchangju/DeepListener/issues) and did not find a duplicate.
- [ ] I checked [`docs/plans/`](https://github.com/zhouchangju/DeepListener/tree/main/docs/plans) and [`docs/todo.md`](https://github.com/zhouchangju/DeepListener/blob/main/docs/todo.md) — this is not already on the backlog.

## Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I'm open to opening a pull request for this (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/zhouchangju/DeepListener/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)).

## Additional context

Screenshots, sketches, references, or examples from other listening/SRS tools.
